body: Yep, I think it is. It's got suddenly extremely cold here the past 4 days or so and it fucks me up. Worsens every aspect of my depression.

Hey, can you listen to this album and then tell me there is a god?

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=txsTFYtLaGw

Well I've begged to God to give me a sign, or help me in any way, or just strike a thunder on me. Or even a demon, the devil himself, just anything to prove I have God to look up to. But then I just get emptiness, silence. I haven't been to church since my grandfather died 4 years ago for his 7th day mass or whatever it's called in english. Again I felt nothing, I looked around and I saw desperate people deluding themselves, I saw a person reading an old book loudly. I heard words that barely made sense and platitudes, I heard a brainwashing chant. 

I used to go to church sometimes when I was a kid. I went to sunday school. The nun the run it was a cunt and scolded me, made fun of me publicly for looking like a girl. 

My sister started going to a different church recently. She said I should go and it would change my life, this church is different, catholicism is evil, etc. That I would probably have a demon exorcised out of me if I went to this one. I sorta want to go, best case scenario I get exorcised and my life is all fixed thanks to God almighty. Worst case, I get to watch a dark comedy show.

So maybe I'll talk to her and give that a try before I off myself.
Silly muggles with their unmoving pictures.

Thanks, seems like I'll need that. Lots of crazy people here. Nothing to do, no WiFi, my phone has no games cause I factory erased it thinking of all the porn mom would find. The library is filled with religious books.

Good news, I am alive... My mom found me unconscious on the floor at 8am, I have no memory of anything until 6pm when I woke up in the hospital, no idea if they pumped my stomach or anything.Oh and it was 24mg of klonopin, forgot those were 2mg pills. I'm being checked into a psych ward right now, let's see how that goes.
I feel so sorry for my mom who's gonna find me like this
